text: ごめんね……　ぼくが　その　ポケモンに　おしえられる　わざは　ないみたい

structure.jp: ぼくが　その　ポケモンに　おしえられる　わざは
structure.en: a move I can teach that Pokémon

patterns.name: 〜られる (potential)
patterns.explanation: られる on a verb here means 'can do' it. おしえられる = 'can teach'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: ぼくが　その　ポケモンに　おしえられる　わざ
patterns.explanation: A phrase ending in a verb placed right before a thing tells you which one, like 'that' in English. ぼくが その ポケモンに おしえられる わざ = 'a move that I can teach that Pokémon'.

patterns.name: 〜みたいだ
patterns.explanation: みたい at the end says 'it looks like' or 'it seems', with だ left off in casual talk. ないみたい = 'it seems there isn't one'.
